data.description: XXII Carat Club Villas – A Legacy of Prestige, Luxury Homes by the Shore.

data.answer:
XXII Carat Club Villas in Palm Jumeirah redefines exclusive waterfront living, offering a gated sanctuary on the serene shores of Dubai’s most iconic island. This prestigious community consists of 22 opulent villas, each designed with 5 to 7 ensuite bedrooms, expansive private gardens, and a seamless blend of privacy and grandeur. Residents enjoy direct access to a pristine 220-metre private beach, complemented by breathtaking views of the Dubai Marina and Palm Jumeirah skyline.

Designed for a lifestyle of luxury and convenience, XXII Carat Palm Jumeirah Dubai offers a wealth of world-class amenities. The waterfront residences come with private beach access, state-of-the-art security, and an array of tailored services. From concierge assistance and 24-hour security to valet parking and secure basement parking, every detail ensures a stress-free and exclusive living experience.

The community also features an 82-ft. central swimming pool with direct beach access, a high-end cabana bar, and a fine-dining restaurant, creating an atmosphere of elegance and leisure. Residents at XXII Carat Villas, Dubai can also take advantage of housekeeping, gardening, pool maintenance, and tech support, ensuring effortless luxury in a setting that epitomizes refined beachfront living.

XXII Carat Club Villas in Palm Jumeirah is a collection of 22 ultra-luxurious villas, featuring seven-bedroom layouts designed for those seeking exclusive waterfront living. The community offers eight Ruby and Emerald villas and six Sapphire villas, with Sapphire and Emerald spanning two floors, while Ruby villas rise across four levels. 

Each home boasts spacious dining and living areas, a private swimming pool, patios, sun decks, and verandahs, along with walk-in closets and private terraces in all ensuite bedrooms. Interiors are adorned with French-made kitchens, Italian-crafted faucets, custom cabinetry, and opulent flooring and doors, defining XXII Carat Villas, Dubai as the epitome of elegance and comfort.

For those seeking a lavish rental experience, XXII Carat Villas, Dubai offers a limited selection of elite waterfront residences with private pools, direct beach access, and premium concierge services. 

These seven-bedroom villas provide landscaped gardens, high-end interiors, and world-class facilities, making them ideal for tenants looking to experience the pinnacle of luxury living in Palm Jumeirah. more_info.question: FAQs About XXII Carat Club Villas Dubai

data.answer:
Who is the developer of XXII Carat Club Villas?

XXII Carat Club Villas is developed by Forum Group, a luxury real estate developer known for creating high-end, exclusive residences in Dubai. The project reflects Mediterranean-inspired architecture combined with premium finishes and world-class amenities.

How much does a villa in XXII Carat Palm Jumeirah Dubai cost?

Prices for villas in XXII Carat Villas, Dubai vary based on size, views, and customization, but they generally fall within the ultra-luxury price range, starting from tens of millions of dirhams. Given its exclusivity, these properties cater to high-net-worth individuals and investors.

Are the villas in XXII Carat available for foreign ownership?

Yes, XXII Carat Palm Jumeirah Dubai is located in a freehold zone, meaning both local and international buyers can own properties with full ownership rights, making it an attractive investment for global investors.

What makes XXII Carat different from other luxury communities in Palm Jumeirah?

Unlike other high-end developments, XXII Carat Club Villas in Palm Jumeirah offers only 22 exclusive villas, ensuring privacy and a boutique-style ultra-luxury experience. Each villa features spacious layouts, private beach access, and world-class concierge services, making it a unique waterfront haven.

Can XXII Carat Villas be rented for short-term stays?

No, XXII Carat Villas is a residential-only development, meaning short-term holiday rentals are not typically permitted. The community is designed for long-term luxury living, catering to end-users and investors looking for exclusivity and privacy.

Nestled on the prestigious Crescent West of Palm Jumeirah, XXII Carat Club Villas is an exclusive beachfront development by Forum Group. Spanning an impressive 500,000 sq. ft., this ultra-luxurious community boasts 22 opulent villas and a one-of-a-kind Diamond Penthouse, offering an unparalleled waterfront lifestyle. Designed with a perfect blend of Italian and Mediterranean influences, these residences provide the ultimate sanctuary for discerning homeowners seeking grandeur and privacy.

The 22 carat features three distinct villa types—Sapphire, Ruby, and Emerald—each designed to exude elegance and sophistication. With spacious seven-bedroom layouts and the penthouse featuring eight ensuite bedrooms, every home is meticulously crafted to deliver comfort, space, and breathtaking panoramic views of Palm Jumeirah and the Dubai Marina skyline. Residents also enjoy exclusive beach access, ensuring a seamless connection to the pristine shores of the Arabian Gulf.

Positioned amidst some of Dubai’s most renowned luxury resorts, including One&Only The Palm, Zabeel Saray, and W Dubai – The Palm, XXII Carat Palm Jumeirah Dubai offers a distinguished address with world-class hospitality and leisure destinations at its doorstep. The community provides seamless connectivity to the mainland via Crescent Road and Palm Jumeirah Road, ensuring effortless access to the city’s key landmarks while maintaining an atmosphere of exclusivity and serenity.
